recipes.name: Easy Fruited Chicken Salad
ingredients_raw: 0.5 teaspoon apple pie spice, or to taste
4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cooked and diced

steps.text: In a bowl, lightly mix the apple, grapes, pecans, apple pie spice, and mayonnaise together until thoroughly combined; stir in the chicken breast meat. Chill until cold.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Fruited Chicken Salad
raw_recipe.description: An easy chicken salad with a twist combines apples, grapes, and pecans with mayonnaise flavored with apple pie spice. Load it onto a plate of salad, stuff it into tomatoes, or wrap it in a tortilla and go. The possibilities are endless.

review.reviewBody: Easy and delicious - plus it's a great way to use up leftover grilled chicken! I cut the recipe in half since I didn't have pecans I subbed toasted walnuts instead. I used a Red Delicious Apple and I also threw in just a bit of chopped celery and some dried cranberries. I mixed the dressing in a separate bowl before folding it into the chicken and other ingredients. For the dressing I used Hellman's light mayo and cut it with a bit of reduced fat sour cream. I used half apple pie spice and half curry powder along with a bit of salt and pepper. It chilled for just a couple of hours and it came out really good. Overall, a great combination of flavors!

I used walnuts instead of pecans, added celery and cranberries, used half mayonnaise and half salad dressing, and used 1/2 apple pie spice (made myself - cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice) and 1/2 curry powder. It was excellent. Next time, however, I will use a little more curry powder and add a touch of salt and pepper. The family loved it though.

We love this recipe, use it for camping and beach trips all the time. I make it ahead of time and it's a nice alternative to the standard travel lunch fare. (Especially when you have small children) I did change it to add some curry powder and a bit of sugar. (Sometimes I don't even add the apple pie spice since the curry has enough unique flavor) Our friends love it and when we camp together with them they ask us to make extra.

This was so similar to Arby's Pecan Chicken salad. I used canned chicken and skipped the apple pie spice since it's got cinnamon in it, and my husband will not eat cinnamon in meat dishes. This took a little time to chop up all the components, but once all the cutting is done, it's fast and easy. I let this sit overnight for the flavors to develop. This was really refreshing and tasty with crackers. I'm sure it would be also great on whole grain wheat bread too, just like the drive thru window, but cheaper. Gathering all the ingredients does cost more to start with, but this yields more for the money overall. We love this stuff. It's pretty good as a lettuce wrap too.
I love this recipe the only change I made to it was I used plain Greek yogurt instead of mayo to make it healthier. Excellent recipe!

This is basically the same as the recipe I love so much. Instead of apple pie spice, I add a tablespoon of dried tarragon. The flavor really comes out after refrigerating for a couple of hours or even overnight. Makes a great sandwich on whole grain bread or, better yet, spread on graham crackers. Delish!

What makes this unique is the apple pie spice which I mixed with mayo (actually used Miracle Whip Light). I halved the recipe, but liked the flavor of the spice so much, I used a full 1/2 teaspoon plus. This takes no time to put together, and I would serve this to company with no qualms at all. It tastes good, and the presentation is lovely.

This is better than your average chicken salad recipe and my husband loved it. I had my doubts about it because of the fruit and apple pie spice but it was good enough that I will make it again. I did use light mayonnaise instead of the full fat variety and I seasoned my chicken breast before cooking them.

I made this for a lunch with a girlfriend. It was fantastic!!! The only change I made was to omit the pecans and I added a little finely diced onion. It was great. The next day my girlfriend sent me a message saying she was craving the chicken salad.
Apple pie spice too strong. Whole pecans give better flavor. I would not make this again. Back to chicken, celery, chopped onion, mayonnaise for me.
Made it as directed, husband and I loved it, Kid (who doesn't really care about chicken salad one way or the other) thought it was pretty good. Thanks!

Simple and SO easy to make!
I just made this for lunch today and made it into a wrap. Heavenly!!! I didn't have all the ingredients though, so I used what I had: salt & pepper instead of the spice, and chopped almonds. 
It was still very good. Next time, I'll definitely try it with the apple pie spice. Thanks for sharing the recipe :)
This was very good, my husband even liked it...great cool summer salad.
I liked the pie spice, but hubby and kids didn't like it.
also added celery salt and pecans and a little dijon mustard. awesome!

Hello... This is jo1527, JO. I tried to edit the recipe but couldn't. I failed to put in the fact what many have figured out. The apple pie spice and mayo are in fact mixed together first before adding to the rest of the ingredients. Enjoy!
